column1: # Deviations from the rule of docs/silicon-datapath.md §5 read literally: atom<TAB>section H<TAB>section L<TAB>section D<TAB>source
# section value: "-" = not driven; "<source>:H" / ":L" = high/low half of the source; ":L6" = bits 5:0 of the low half; "sext:L" = 16 copies of bit 15 of the L section of the same atom

# CONFIRMED = source independent of the RTL and of the generators (patent, manual, measurements against the reference core with comparison benches made during development, not part of this repository (available from the author on request: diff-fuzz-si per instruction family, lockstep-si, reset)). IMPLEMENTATION CHOICE = no external source, because not observable from the behaviour:
# the 16-bit register half is replicated on the twin section; the only App. H destinations for these transfers are consumers that read with fallback
# D->L->H or H->L->D (alu, alub, dob, ftu, dcr, ath), and no microcode word drives two different sources on the same section (bussec testbench: 0 conflicts over 522 words).
